item.title: Dabo Swinney Comments on Clemson WR's Lack of Snaps

item.title: Clemson's Dabo Swinney Discusses Virginia Tech Hiring James Franklin
item.description: On Monday, Virginia Tech announced the hiring of James Franklin as its next head football coach. Franklin will be officially introduced at a press conference on Wednesday morning.
